verdict.rationale: kitty's first-party ssh kitten logs into remote hosts and automatically sets up the remote environment "to be as comfortable as your local shell." It adds automatic shell integration, file transfer, connection reuse and remote-control socket forwarding (kitty-docs-4, kitty-docs-26), with shell integration covered further in kitty-docs-3. Community reports of xterm-kitty TERM breakage on remote hosts describe plain ssh, not the kitten, so they reflect the problem the kitten addresses rather than contradicting it. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that terminfo is copied to the remote, explicit evidence of local config/dotfiles being carried over, and independent hands-on corroboration of the kitten.
